injections.name: a-subcommand-the-table-forgot-is-not-noticed
injections.why: the table is the thing under measurement, so a name missing from it has to stop the run rather than pass quietly — `cargo check` renamed here is a subcommand this repository issues and nothing classifies

injections.name: a-name-the-table-says-compiles-nothing-is-never-put-to-cargo
injections.why: R1272's sharpest clause. The population is the TREE's, so a `false` the tree does not issue — `package` and `tree` are both — is never run and never complained about; and `false` is the answer that makes a caller skip a clean. Dropping the sweep leaves those entries asserted on nobody's authority, and every other assertion here still passes

injections.name: a-fingerprint-below-the-first-level-is-not-counted
